blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Applications of Computer Science) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 8 number ka hai (definition, misalon ke saath wazahat, farq, program likh kar samjhana), aksar definition aur wazahat ke hisson mein (jaise 2 + 3 x 2). Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define Artificial Intelligence (2). Explain how AI systems learn through machine learning (3) and how AI works by combining data, algorithms and computing power (3). (8 marks)
(Artificial Intelligence ki definition likhein (2). Samjhayein ke AI machine learning se kaise seekhta hai (3) aur data, algorithms aur computing power mila kar kaise kaam karta hai (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: AI computer science ki woh shaakh hai jo machines ko aise kaam karne deti hai jin ke liye aam tor par insani zehanat chahiye. Yeh computer ko data analyze karne, patterns pehchanne aur kam insani madad se faisle karne deti hai.

Machine learning (machine ka seekhna): AI tajurbe se machine learning ke zariye seekhta hai. Algorithms bade data sets par train ho kar trends pehchante aur waqt ke saath behtar hote hain. Jitna zyada data process ho, utne durust nataij.

AI kaise kaam karta hai: AI data, algorithms aur computing power ko mila kar speech samajhna, tasveer mein cheezein pehchanna aur nataij predict karna jaise kaam karta hai. Yeh Neural Networks (NN) aur Natural Language Processing (NLP) se insani dimagh ke kaam ki naqal karta hai. Is se AI pechida masail hal karta, kaam khud kaar banata aur wahan madad karta hai jahan riwayati programming ghair yaqeeni halaat ya bohat zyada maloomat handle nahin kar sakti.

book_ref.quote: AI systems learn from experience through a process called machine learning

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain any four common applications of AI, giving an example of each from the chapter (4 x 2). (8 marks)
(AI ki chaar aam applications samjhayein, har aik ki chapter se misal ke saath (4 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
1. Voice assistants: bole gaye commands samajh kar maloomat ya amal se jawab dete hain. Misal: Siri, Alexa, Google Assistant.

2. Chatbots: websites par customers ke sawalon ke jawab dete hain; maslan Amazon aur Daraz ke chatbots hazaron users ko "Where is my order?" ka jawab aik saath dete hain.

3. Image recognition: photos aur scans se chehre, cheezein ya bimariyan pehchante hain; maslan DeepMind ka AI 3D eye scans se glaucoma jaisi bimari predict karne mein madad karta hai.

4. Recommendation systems: YouTube, Daraz aur Amazon par AI user ki pasand ke mutabiq videos ya products suggest karta hai.

(Self-driving cars bhi AI se ird-gird samajh kar mehfooz driving ke faisle karti hain.) Yeh applications technology ko zyada interactive, efficient aur adaptive banati hain.

book_ref.quote: These applications make technology more interactive, efficient, and adaptive

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein recommendation systems wali jagah 'Draz' chhapa hai; sahi naam Daraz hai, jaisa agle hisse mein kitab khud likhti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 AI increases efficiency, accuracy and convenience. Explain how AI benefits each of these four areas, with the chapter's examples: healthcare, business, education and agriculture (4 x 2). (8 marks)
(AI efficiency, accuracy aur convenience barhata hai. Chapter ki misalon ke saath samjhayein ke AI in chaar shobon ko kaise faida deta hai: healthcare, business, taleem aur zarat (4 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
1. Healthcare: AI doctors ki tashkhees mein madad karta hai. DeepMind ka AI 3D eye scans dekh kar glaucoma jaisi bimari wazeh alamaat se pehle predict karne mein madad karta hai.

2. Business: Amazon aur Daraz AI chatbots se "Where is my order?" jaise sawalon ka hazaron users ko aik saath jawab dete hain. Karobar AI se customer ka rawaiya parakhte, trends predict karte aur behtar faisle karte hain.

3. Taleem: AI personalized learning aur adaptive tutoring systems se madad karta hai.

4. Zarat: AI faslon ki behtar nigrani mein madad karta hai; kisaan drones aur sensors ke saath AI se paidawar barhate aur zaya kam karte hain.

Aam tor par AI dohraye jane wale kaam insanon se tez karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Businesses also use AI to analyze customer behavior, predict trends, and improve decision-making.

blocks.prompt:
4 Define the Internet of Things (2). Explain its three main functions, data collection, communication and automation, with an example of each (3 x 2). (8 marks)
(Internet of Things ki definition likhein (2). Is ke teen bunyadi functions, data collection, communication aur automation, misal ke saath samjhayein (3 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: IoT internet se jure physical devices ka network hai jo data jama, share aur us par amal karte hain. In mein aksar sensors, processors aur communication hardware hote hain.

1. Data collection: sensors mahol se temperature, harkat ya nami ka data jama karte hain. Misal: khet ke soil sensors mitti ki nami naapte hain.

2. Communication: data cloud systems ya servers ko jata hai jahan process aur analyze hota hai. Devices Wi-Fi, Bluetooth ya cellular networks se jure hote hain aur aapas ka rabta systems ko synchronized aur efficient rakhta hai. Misal: security camera seedha smartphone par alert bhejta hai.

3. Automation: analyze shuda data khud ba khud amal shuru karta hai, haath ka control kam, waqt ki bachat aur insani ghalti kam. Misal: kamre mein koi na ho to lights band, ya mitti khushk ho to aabpashi shuru.

book_ref.quote: IoT works through three main functions: data collection, communication, and automation.

blocks.prompt:
5 Define cloud computing and explain the role of cloud service providers (3). Explain why cloud computing is cost-effective (2). Describe the cloud platforms AWS and Microsoft Azure (3). (8 marks)
(Cloud computing ki definition aur cloud service providers ka kirdar samjhayein (3). Cloud computing kifayati kyun hai (2). AWS aur Microsoft Azure ko bayan karein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Definition aur providers: cloud computing data ko local computer ke bajaye remote servers par store, manage aur process karne deti hai. Yeh servers internet par hote hain aur cloud service providers inhein sambhalte hain, is liye user kahin se bhi kisi bhi waqt internet ke zariye data aur applications tak pohanch sakta hai. Processing door hoti hai, is liye taqatwar PC aur apna hardware sambhalne ki zaroorat nahin.

Kifayat: mehenge servers aur maintenance staff ki zaroorat kam hoti hai. User pay-as-you-go model mein sirf istemal ki gayi services ka paisa deta hai, is se kharcha kam hota hai.

Platforms: Amazon Web Services (AWS) web hosting, data storage aur application development ki bohat si cloud services deta hai aur duniya bhar ke karobar ise istemal karte hain. Microsoft Azure bhi aisi hi salahiyat deta hai aur developers cloud ke zariye applications bana aur sambhal sakte hain. Yeh platforms zaati files se le kar bade karobari hal tak madad karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These servers are hosted on the internet and managed by cloud service providers.

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between cloud computing and blockchain technology in a table (4). Explain any four uses of blockchain described in the chapter (4). (8 marks)
(Cloud computing aur blockchain mein farq table mein likhein (4). Chapter mein bataye gaye blockchain ke chaar istemal samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Farq: table dekhein.

Blockchain ke istemal:
1. Finance: Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrencies ke mehfooz peer-to-peer len-den.
2. Supply chain: maal ko shuru se customer tak track kar ke asliyat yaqeeni banana.
3. Data security: legal documents, medical files aur certificates ka tamper-proof storage.
4. Hukoomat, companiyan aur school: zameen ke records, supply chains aur taleemi asnaad sambhalna.
Majmooi tor par blockchain digital systems mein aitbaar, shaffafiyat aur efficiency barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Overall, blockchain enhances reliability, transparency, and efficiency in digital systems.

rows: Data local computer ke bajaye remote servers par store aur process hota hai.
Maloomat aik markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par hoti hai.
Servers internet par hote hain aur cloud providers sambhalte hain.
Decentralized: har computer ke paas copy; banks ya hukoomat jaise intermediaries nahin.
Data aur applications kahin se bhi kisi bhi waqt.
Har tasdeeq shuda block pichhle se jur kar na badalne wali chain banata hai.
Khoobiyan: shaffafiyat, security, aitbaar; chupke se data badalna taqreeban namumkin.
Misal: Google Drive, iCloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure.
Misal: Bitcoin, supply chain tracking, zameen ke records.

blocks.prompt:
7 Define stakeholders (2). Explain the role and concerns of each of the four stakeholders of AI systems: developers, users, governments and communities (4 x 1.5). (8 marks)
(Stakeholders ki definition likhein (2). AI systems ke chaar stakeholders, developers, users, hukoomat aur communities, ka kirdar aur fikrein samjhayein (4 x 1.5).)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: stakeholders woh afraad ya groups hain jin par technology system ka asar parta hai. AI mein kai stakeholders hote hain; har group AI ke nizam mein hissa dalta aur us ki taraqqi par asar dalta hai.

1. Developers: functionality, innovation aur performance par tawajjuh de kar AI banate hain; system ko durust, munsif aur akhlaqi banate hain.

2. Users: rozana AI istemal karte hain aur aasan aur qabil-e-aitbaar system chahte hain; privacy, security aur durust nataij ki fikr karte hain.

3. Hukoomat: AI ke mehfooz aur munsif istemal ke liye policies aur regulations banati hai; awam ke mafaad ki hifazat aur qanoon par amal karwati hai.

4. Communities: AI ka asar mehsoos karti hain; samaji aqdaar aur saqafati usool bachati aur zimmedar istemal ko farogh deti hain.

book_ref.quote: Each group contributes to the overall ecosystem of AI and influences how it evolves.

blocks.prompt:
8 Define conflict of interest (2). Explain the competing priorities of businesses, users and governments (3). Explain data collection as an example of conflict and how it can be balanced (3). (8 marks)
(Conflict of interest ki definition likhein (2). Businesses, users aur hukoomat ki takrati tarjeehat samjhayein (3). Data collection ko conflict ki misal ke tor par aur us ka tawazun samjhayein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: conflict of interest tab hota hai jab aik stakeholder ke maqasid ya faide doosron ke huqooq, hifazat ya mafaad ko nuqsan dein. Yeh aksar takrati tarjeehat se paida hota hai.

Takrati tarjeehat: businesses innovation aur munafe ke liye data jama karna chahte hain, jabke users privacy aur apni maloomat par ikhtiyar chahte hain. Hukoomat ko maashi taraqqi aur shehriyon ke huqooq aur akhlaqi meyar mein tawazun rakhna hota hai.

Misal aur tawazun: data collection aam misal hai. Companiyan AI behtar karne ke liye bohat sa data jama karti hain, magar wazeh ijazat (explicit consent) ke baghair yeh privacy aur aitbaar todta hai. Shaffaf data policies aur aasan consent mechanisms functionality aur ethics mein munasib tawazun laate hain. Privacy aur innovation ka tawazun aaj ki tech duniya ka bada challenge hai.

book_ref.quote: Transparent data policies and user-friendly consent mechanisms help achieve a fair balance

blocks.prompt:
9 Define ethical AI (2). Explain the four principles fairness, accountability, transparency and safety, using the chapter's student-admission and disease-diagnosis examples (6). (8 marks)
(Ethical AI ki definition likhein (2). Fairness, accountability, transparency aur safety ke chaar usool, chapter ki admission aur diagnosis misalon se samjhayein (6).)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: ethical AI ka matlab hai AI systems ko munsif, shaffaf, jawabdeh, mehfooz aur zimmedar tareeqe se banana aur istemal karna.

1. Fairness (imtiyaz rokna): admission AI gender, ilaqe, zaban ya pas-e-manzar ki buniyad par kisi ko tarjeeh ya rad na kare.

2. Accountability (zimmedari tay karna): wazeh ho ke system ghair munsifana faisla kare to zimmedar kaun hai.

3. Transparency (faislon ki wazahat): university bata sake ke talib-e-ilm kyun select ya rad hua.

4. Safety (nuqsan se bachana): healthcare mein diagnosis AI ko ehtiyat se test kiya jaye taake nuqsan deh ya gumrah kun nataij na de.

Yeh usool AI ko insani faide ka auzaar rakhte hain aur anchahe bure nataij se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: Ethical AI development requires fairness to prevent discrimination

blocks.prompt:
10 Define bias in AI and inclusivity (2 + 2). Explain, with the chapter's two examples, how hidden bias in datasets leads to unfair AI, and what developers must do (4). (8 marks)
(AI mein bias aur inclusivity ki definition likhein (2 + 2). Chapter ki do misalon se samjhayein ke datasets ka chhupa bias AI ko ghair munsif kaise banata hai aur developers ko kya karna chahiye (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Bias in AI: jab AI biased data, kamzor design ya groups ki ghair barabar numaindagi ki wajah se ghair munsifana nataij de.

Inclusivity: technology ko aisa banana ke mukhtalif gender, saqafat, zaban, ilaqe aur pas-e-manzar ke logon ki barabar khidmat kare; AI design mein mukhtalif nuqta-e-nazar shamil karna.

Bias kaise aata hai: AI bade datasets se seekhta hai jin mein chhupa bias ho sakta hai.
1. Hiring: agar system aise records par train ho jahan mard zyada select hue, to AI mard umeedwaron ko ghair munsifana tarjeeh de sakta hai.
2. Face recognition: agar zyada tar aik umar, rang ya ilaqe ki tasveerein hon, to doosre groups ke liye kamzor kaam karta hai.
Developers ka kaam: datasets ka ehtiyat se jaiza le kar durust karna taake kisi fard ya group se na-insafi na ho, aur gender, nasl ya pas-e-manzar se qata-e-nazar sab ke nuqta-e-nazar shamil karna.

book_ref.quote: Developers must carefully review and adjust these datasets to avoid unfair treatment

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain how cultural diversity affects the design of AI systems (4). Explain, with the chapter's examples, how privacy preferences and languages must be handled in AI design (4). (8 marks)
(Samjhayein ke saqafati tanawwu AI ke design par kaise asar dalta hai (4). Chapter ki misalon se samjhayein ke AI design mein privacy ki pasand aur zabanon ko kaise sambhala jaye (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Saqafati tanawwu ka asar: saqafati tanawwu duniya bhar mein AI ke design, us ke bare mein raaye aur us ke nifaz par asar dalta hai. Saqafati aqdaar privacy, guftagu ke andaz aur technology apnane ki tawaqqoaat badalti hain. Is liye designers ko maqami riwayaat aur rawaiye dekhne chahiyein taake AI tools har saqafat ke liye qabil-e-rasai aur ba-ehtiraam hon. Jo AI mukhtalif zabanein aur saqafatein samjhe woh har pas-e-manzar ke logon ki behtar khidmat karta hai.

Privacy ki pasand: yeh ilaqon mein mukhtalif hai; kuch muashre data share karne mein aasani mehsoos karte hain aur kuch sakht raazdari chahte hain. AI design ko is farq ka ehtiraam karna chahiye.

Zabanein: language models mein mukhtalif zabanein aur lehje shamil hon taake ghalib saqafaton ki taraf jhukao na ho. AI ke faisle bhi maqami riwayaat aur samaji usoolon ka lehaz rakhein taake insaf aur qabooliyat ho.

book_ref.quote: Cultural diversity affects how AI systems are designed, perceived, and implemented around the world.

blocks.prompt:
12 Define policy and legal frameworks (2). Describe two international frameworks that guide responsible AI use (3). Explain what national AI policies can do for Pakistan (3). (8 marks)
(Policy and legal frameworks ki definition likhein (2). Zimmedar AI ke do aalmi frameworks bayan karein (3). Samjhayein ke qaumi AI policies Pakistan ke liye kya kar sakti hain (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: policy and legal frameworks woh qawaid aur qanoon hain jo technologies ki tayyari, istemal aur control ki rehnumai karte hain taake afraad, idare aur muashra mehfooz rahein.

Aalmi frameworks:
1. GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation): European Union ka; data privacy aur user ke huqooq ke sakht qawaid lagu karta hai.
2. AI Ethics Guidelines: duniya bhar ke idaron ki; jawabdehi, insaf aur insani waqar ke ehtiraam par zor deti hain.
Yeh frameworks mumalik aur companiyon ko zimmedar AI apnane par ubharte hain.

Pakistan ke liye qaumi AI policies: innovation aur akhlaqi pabandi dono ke liye zaroori hain. Yeh data protection regulate karti, research barhati aur maqami aqdaar ke mutabiq AI hal ki madad karti hain. Akhlaqi meyar awam ka aitbaar banate, aalmi partnerships laate aur qaumi taraqqi mein AI ka musbat hissa yaqeeni banate hain.

book_ref.quote: AI Ethics Guidelines developed by organizations worldwide emphasize accountability

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain how an innovative application using emerging technologies is designed (4). Explain technology integration with the smart irrigation system as an example (4). (8 marks)
(Samjhayein ke emerging technologies se innovative application kaise design hoti hai (4). Technology integration ko smart irrigation system ki misal se samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Application design:
1. Aik haqeeqi masla pehchan kar us ke liye sahi tools chunna, jaise AI tutoring ke liye, IoT smart city ke liye, Cloud mehfooz data rasai ke liye aur Blockchain record ki tasdeeq ke liye.
2. Talaba Pakistan ki samaji aur maashi zarooraton par mabni ideas sochte hain.
3. Innovation tab phalti hai jab creativity maqsad se mile: design-thinking se user par markooz, maqami halaat ke mutabiq amli hal.
4. Pani ke intezam, traffic control ya taleem tak rasai ke projects tanqeedi soch aur community ki taraqqi barhate hain.

Technology integration: achhe hal aksar aik se zyada technologies milate hain. AI ki zehanat, IoT ka rabta, Cloud ki scalability aur Blockchain ki security mil kar taqatwar, data par mabni systems banate hain jo waqt ke saath behtar hote hain.
Misal, smart irrigation: IoT sensors mitti ki nami naapte, AI algorithms pani ki zaroorat predict karte aur Cloud storage data jama aur analyze karta hai. Is se pani ki bachat, kam kharcha aur zyada paidawar hoti hai, aur Pakistan mein pa-edar zarat aur mahol ki hifazat hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Students are encouraged to brainstorm ideas that directly address Pakistan's social and economic needs.

blocks.prompt:
14 Smart agriculture uses IoT, AI, cloud computing and blockchain to improve farming. Explain the role of each of these four technologies in the chapter's case study on smart agriculture in Pakistan (4 x 2). (8 marks)
(Smart agriculture kheti behtar karne ke liye IoT, AI, cloud computing aur blockchain istemal karti hai. Chapter ke Pakistan mein smart agriculture case study mein har technology ka kirdar samjhayein (4 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
1. Mitti ki nigrani ke liye IoT sensors: mitti ki nami, hararat aur nutrients ka real time data jama karte hain. Kisaan data par mabni faisle karte hain, jaise faslon ko kab aur kitna pani dena hai; kaam behtar aur wasail mehfooz.

2. Mausam ki peshgoi ke liye AI: AI mausam ka data analyze kar ke barish, khushk sali ya hararat ke patterns predict karta hai. Kisaan kaam plan kar ke faslon ko mausmi nuqsan se bachate hain; paidawar zyada, nuqsan kam.

3. Data storage ke liye Cloud: kisaanon, mohaqqiqeen aur policy makers ko zarai data ka scalable storage aur jaldi rasai.

4. Supply chain ke liye Blockchain: fasal ki paidawar aur taqseem ke har marhale ka record, dhoka kam aur munsifana tijarat.

Mil kar yeh technologies Pakistan ke mustaqbil ke liye pa-edar aur qabil-e-aitbaar zarai nizam banati hain.

book_ref.quote: Blockchain adds transparency to the supply chain by recording each stage of crop production

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain why technology-based solutions for Pakistan must respect local cultures (4) and why technological innovation must prioritise ethical responsibility (4). (8 marks)
(Samjhayein ke Pakistan ke liye technology hal maqami saqafat ka ehtiraam kyun karein (4) aur technological innovation akhlaqi zimmedari ko tarjeeh kyun de (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Maqami saqafat ka ehtiraam: Pakistan mein mukhtalif saqafatein, riwayaat aur aqdaar hain. Technology hal banate waqt applications inclusive, qabil-e-rasai aur maqami riwayaat ka ehtiraam karne wali hon. Maslan AI ki zaban aur mawad ilaqai tanawwu aur samaji hassasiyat ko zahir kare. Technology tab kamyab hoti hai jab maqami riwayaat, aqaid aur user ki zaroorat ka ehtiraam kare.

Akhlaqi zimmedari: innovation hamesha akhlaqi zimmedari ko tarjeeh de. Data ka ghalat istemal, privacy mein dakhal ya saqafati tor par na-munasib mawad be-aitbaari paida kar ke communities ko nuqsan dete hain. Is liye talaba aisi applications banayein jo insaf, ehtiraam aur musbat samaji asar barhayein, taake technology taraqqi ki musbat quwwat rahe.

book_ref.quote: Students should design applications that promote fairness, respect, and positive social impact

blocks.prompt:
16 Define AI governance (2). Explain why emerging technologies need laws and policies, and what policies define (3). Describe global and national efforts in AI governance (3). (8 marks)
(AI governance ki definition likhein (2). Samjhayein ke emerging technologies ko qanoon aur policies ki zaroorat kyun hai aur policies kya tay karti hain (3). AI governance ki aalmi aur qaumi koshishein bayan karein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: AI governance woh qawaid, policies aur hidayat hain jo AI systems ki zimmedar tayyari aur istemal yaqeeni banati hain.

Qanoon ki zaroorat: AI, IoT aur Blockchain privacy, rozgar, faisla sazi aur security tak zindagi ke kai pehluon par asar dalti hain. Munasib qanoon ke baghair in ka ghalat istemal ya ghair munsifana nataij ho sakte hain. Policies tay karti hain ke data kaise jama, store aur istemal ho, taake hifazat aur afraad ke huqooq mehfooz rahein.

Aalmi aur qaumi koshishein: aalmi satah par Europe ka GDPR data protection aur privacy ke meyar tay karta hai, aur aalmi AI ethics guidelines khud kaar faislon mein shaffafiyat aur insaf barhati hain. Qaumi satah par mumalik apni AI strategies bana rahe hain. Pakistan aise frameworks apna kar taraqqi ko akhlaqi meyar ke mutabiq aur shehriyon ke mafaad ko mehfooz rakh sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Policies help define how data should be collected, stored, and used

blocks.prompt:
17 Explain collaboration across disciplines and the role of legal experts, sociologists and ethicists (4). Define responsible innovation and explain how developers can develop responsible technology (4). (8 marks)
(Mukhtalif shobon ke ishtirak aur legal experts, sociologists aur ethicists ka kirdar samjhayein (4). Responsible innovation ki definition likhein aur samjhayein ke developers zimmedar technology kaise banayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Mukhtalif shobon ka ishtirak: zimmedar aur munsif technology ke liye mukhtalif shobon ke mahireen ka mil kar kaam karna zaroori hai.
1. Legal experts qanoon ki pabandi yaqeeni banate hain.
2. Sociologists technology ke samaji asar ka mutala karte hain.
3. Ethicists akhlaqi faislon ki rehnumai karte hain.
Mil kar yeh mutawazin hal banate hain jo logon ko bachate aur innovation ki madad karte hain. Hal un logon ke tanawwu ki numaindagi karein jin ki khidmat karte hain; zaban, saqafat aur rasai ke farq dekh kar aise system bante hain jo sab ke liye kaam karein. Yeh ishtirak innovation ko inclusive, munsif aur pa-edar rakhta hai.

Responsible innovation: sirf maali faide ke bajaye insani bhalai par tawajjuh; aisi technology jo haqeeqi masail hal kare aur akhlaq, hifazat, saqafat, insaf aur lambe arse ke samaji asar ka khayal rakhe.
Zimmedar technology: zindagi behtar karne, mauqe paida karne aur nuqsan kam karne ke liye banayi jaye. Developers lambe arse ke samaji aur mahoolyati asraat dekhein taake faida sab communities ko barabar mile. Behtareen technologies logon ko pehle rakhti hain; akhlaq aur hamdardi innovation ke aham ajza hain.

book_ref.quote: Working together, these experts help create balanced solutions that protect people while supporting innovation.

blocks.prompt:
18 Define the following terms from the chapter (8 x 1): emerging technologies, Internet of Things, cloud computing, blockchain, inclusivity, AI governance, smart agriculture, technology integration. (8 marks)
(Chapter ki yeh istilahat define karein (8 x 1): emerging technologies, Internet of Things, cloud computing, blockchain, inclusivity, AI governance, smart agriculture, technology integration.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Emerging technologies: nayi ya tezi se taraqqi karti technologies jo rehne, kaam, rabte aur masail hal karne ka tareeqa badal sakti hain.
2. Internet of Things: Internet se jure physical devices jo data jama, share aur us par amal karte hain, jaise smart watches, smart lights, smart cameras aur soil sensors.
3. Cloud computing: Internet par mabni services se data store karna, applications chalana aur computing wasail istemal karna, sirf local computer ya server par inhisaar ke baghair.
4. Blockchain: record rakhne ki digital technology jis mein data jure hue blocks mein hota hai; mehfooz, shaffaf aur tamper-resistant len-den ki madad karti hai.
5. Inclusivity: technology ko aisa banana ke mukhtalif gender, saqafat, zaban, ilaqe aur pas-e-manzar ke logon ki barabar khidmat kare.
6. AI governance: woh qawaid, policies aur hidayat jo AI ki zimmedar tayyari aur istemal yaqeeni banati hain.
7. Smart agriculture: kheti behtar karne ke liye IoT, AI, cloud computing aur blockchain ka istemal.
8. Technology integration: mukhtalif technologies mila kar zyada mufeed hal banana, jaise zarai nizam mein IoT data ke liye, AI peshgoi ke liye, cloud storage ke liye aur blockchain mehfooz records ke liye.

book_ref.quote: Inclusivity means designing technology so that it can serve people from different genders
